mistakes.text: The stag, which antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the stag which antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “whose” for possession (the stag's antlers): “whose antlers”, not “which antlers”.

mistakes.text: The deer, which antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the deer which antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “whose” for possession (the stag's antlers): “whose antlers”, not “which antlers”.

mistakes.text: The stag, whose the antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the stag whose the antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „whose“ nepatrí člen, „whose“ ho nahrádza: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „whose“ se člen nepíše, „whose“ ho nahrazuje: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Whose” already works like a determiner, so no article follows it: “whose antlers”.

mistakes.text: The deer, whose the antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the deer whose the antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „whose“ nepatrí člen, „whose“ ho nahrádza: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „whose“ se člen nepíše, „whose“ ho nahrazuje: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Whose” already works like a determiner, so no article follows it: “whose antlers”.

mistakes.text: The stag, who antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the stag who antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Who“ nevyjadruje vlastníctvo. Pri „ktorého parohy“ treba „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Who“ nevyjadřuje vlastnictví. U „jehož parohy“ je potřeba „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Who” can't show possession; for the stag's antlers use “whose antlers”.

mistakes.text: The deer, who antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.

mistakes.text: The stag, its antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.normalized: the stag its antlers were huge stood among the leaves
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cez „its“ sa vety takto spojiť nedajú. Vedľajšiu vetu uvedie „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pomocí „its“ se věty takto spojit nedají. Vedlejší větu uvede „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “its antlers were huge” can't sit inside the sentence like this; a relative clause needs “whose”.
